text: Pest #2 (ដង្កូវ, caterpillar, exact name uncertain — see caveat). A second caterpillar pest, smaller than the looper caterpillar above but similar in general shape, with several color/striping variations. It feeds on leaves in a way that leaves them riddled with small holes, giving a lace- or net-like appearance, and it characteristically rests close to the soil surface rather than higher on the plant.
caveat: The exact Khmer name for this pest was not clearly legible in the source scan (rendered in a decorative font that could not be confidently transcribed); recommend confirming the precise species/common name against a clearer scan or a follow-up source before publishing this pest's name to end users.
